turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, you're speaking with Hannah. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I've had a burst pipe in my kitchen and I'm panicking, I don't know what to do.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Ah, that sounds really frustrating. Let's see what we can do. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Imran Rahman, 23 December 1956.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: One more thing for the record, what's your online account password?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Er, I'd rather not say that over the phone.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: No problem, the other details are enough.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've had a water leak at home and you'd like to make a claim. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Could you tell me exactly what happened, and when it happened?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It started about an hour ago. The pipe under the kitchen sink burst and water's gone across the whole floor.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. Was anyone injured, and how extensive is the damage?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Everyone's safe, but the floor and the bottom of the cabinets are soaked and some electrics are close by.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: And can you confirm the address of the property?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's 14 Larch Avenue.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. Because it's an emergency you can arrange an urgent repair yourself, up to $500, without needing our approval first. Just keep every receipt.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Right, I see.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks. I've logged your claim under reference CLM-61014, and the home claims team will contact you about the repairs.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've taken the details of your claim and passed it to the home claims team.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
